calls.title: Rakesh Kumar and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: The meeting focused on the verification of a split URL experiment setup that spanned WordPress and Shopify sites, confirming that event tracking from Google Analytics to BigQuery was operational. Rakesh Kumar presented the configurations, while Graham McNicoll confirmed data integrity despite typical issues associated with event loss due to loading delays. Adjustments were discussed, including a new tracking script to store events locally to prevent loss during redirects. Integration with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager was confirmed to work effectively, eliminating redundant code. A debugging strategy utilizing console logs was developed to monitor event firing and confirm system performance. Next steps involve a 24-hour monitoring phase to refine the setup for multiple store scalability.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Google Analytics, Split URL experiment, Google Tag Manager, Event recording, Redirect tracking
calls.action_items:
**Rakesh Kumar**
Implement Graham’s updated event recording script with local storage fixes and remove redundant GA4 loading in GrowthBook script (18:32)
Add console logs to GrowthBook script for debugging event firing and integration with Google Analytics via gtag and dataLayer (25:48)
Test experiment behavior and event firing in different browsers and incognito mode to verify redirect and variant assignment reliability (29:33)
Monitor real-time events in Google Analytics over the next 24 hours to confirm experiment data integrity and traffic split accuracy (33:30)
Rephase the experiment in GrowthBook platform to start a fresh data collection phase after script fixes (34:31)
Report back to Graham via email if further issues arise or adjustments are needed (34:44)

**Graham McNicoll**
Provide Rakesh with the updated event recording gist/script optimized for Google Tag Manager and redirect race conditions (10:34)
Assist with reviewing Rakesh’s script modifications and provide guidance for removing redundant callbacks and GA4 loads (14:44)
Support debugging steps through console logging, network inspection, and event tracking strategy (21:04)
Confirm GrowthBook’s handling of experiment events through gtag/dataLayer and offer troubleshooting advice (15:25)
Remain available for follow-up support after Rakesh tests and rephases the experiment (34:44)
